declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: conventions-ux (Interactions & Animations): never transition `all`, and animate only compositable properties (transform, opacity, colours, shadows); a layout property forces a layout recalc on every frame. Found "%s: %s".

rule-selector-property-disallowed-list.message: conventions-ux (Interactions & Animations): animate transform and opacity only. The `%s` frame animates `%s`, which forces a layout recalc on every frame; use scale/translate instead.
